description: Hand-curated GIFs for the Discord auction narrator. Each scenario fires with `probability_pct` chance when its trigger matches the event. When a scenario fires, a random GIF from its `gifs` array is picked (weighted by `weight` if set, defaults to 1). When no scenario fires OR a scenario fires but has empty `gifs`, falls back to the existing per-event Giphy search.

schema.scenario_id: stable string; referenced by worker logs
schema.label: short human-readable description
schema.trigger: object — all fields must match for the scenario to qualify. Fields: event_kind (nom|forced_increase|overtake|won), min_total_bids, max_total_bids, min_forced, min_overtakes, position (QB|RB|WR|TE|K|PN|DL|LB|DB|S|CB), min_bid_k, by_commish (true|false)
schema.probability_pct: 0-100; when the scenario qualifies, this is the chance of using a curated GIF vs. falling through. 100 = always use this scenario's GIFs when triggered.
schema.gifs: array of { url, label?, weight? }; weight defaults to 1; one random pick weighted by weight.

scenarios.label: Top-decile bidding war — 10+ bids, multi-day fight (D10 of total_bids per analysis)
4+ forced increases on a lot — MFL grinding two proxy ceilings (D10 of forced)
Overtake that ends a 5+ bid lot decisively
Lot won at the 24h MFL minimum (no late drama; 30% of contested lots per analysis)
QB nomination opening at a high price ($10K+)
